_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) Functionally Significant Item (FSI) Index
summary: The RCM Functionally Significant Item (FSI) Index defines the items that are functionally significant and selected for further RCM analysis.
use_relationship:
The Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) Functionally Significant Items (FSI) Index defines the items that are functionally significant and selected for further analysis.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, preparation instructions and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in 5.1.3 of MIL-STD-3034A.
This DID is related to DI-PSSS-80979B, RCM Master Systems and Subsystems Index (MSSI); DI-PSSS-80994B, RCM Functional Block Diagram (FBD); DI-PSSS-80981B, RCM Functional Failure Analysis (FFA) Report; DI-PSSS-80983B, RCM Additional Functionally Significant Item (AFSI) Selection Report; DI-PSSS-80980B, RCM Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Report; DI-PSSS-80984B, RCM Decision Logic Tree Analysis (LTA) with Supporting Rationale and Justification Report; DI-PSSS-80985B, RCM Servicing and Lubrication Analysis (SLA) Report; DI-PSSS-80989B, RCM Inactive Equipment Maintenance (IEM) Requirement Analysis Report; DI-PSSS-81829A, RCM Corrective Maintenance (CM) Development Report; DI-PSSS-80986B, RCM Maintenance Requirements Index (MRI); DI-PSSS-80988B, RCM Task Definition Report; DI-PSSS-80987B, RCM Procedure Validation Report; DI-PSSS-80990A, RCM Documentation Control Sheet.
This DID supersedes DI-SESS-80982A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The FSI index shall be in a format similar to that of the sample form of Figure 1 of this DID.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The FSI index shall contain all of the information specified in the sample form of Figure 1 of this DID and as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.3.3.

children.title: Block 1. System/Subsystem ESWBS Number.
children.content: Enter the highest level Expanded Ship Work Breakdown Structure (ESWBS) number to be covered by the index.

children.title: Block 2. System/Subsystem Nomenclature.
children.content: Enter the associated system/subsystem nomenclature for the ESWBS number specified in block 1.

children.title: Block 3. Ship Class.
children.content: Enter the ship class and hull number to which the RCM analysis applies.

children.title: Block 4. Prepared By.
children.content: Enter the analyst's name and the date.

children.title: Block 5. Reviewed By.
children.content: Enter the first level reviewer's name and the date.

children.title: Block 6. Approved By.
children.content: Reserved for the Maintenance Coordinating Activity (MCA) approval signature and date.

children.title: Block 7. Revision.
children.content: Identify the revision level of the FSI index and enter e.g. "ORIGINAL", "A", "B", "C", etc., sequentially as applicable and the date.

children.title: Block 8. ESWBS Number.
children.content: Enter the entry from each Functional Failure Analysis (FFA) Report form, block 1, and from each Additional Functionally Significant Item (AFSI) Selection Report form, block 1 that had a "YES" in block 15, as applicable.

children.title: Block 9. Nomenclature.
children.content: Enter the entry from each FFA form, block 2, and from each AFSI Selection form, block 2, as applicable.

children.title: Block 10. Location.
children.content: Enter the entry from block 9 of the AFSI Selection form for the item (equipment only).

children.title: Block 11. Serial Number.
children.content: Enter a four-segment serial number as follows:

children.title: Segment 1 - Enter the developing organization abbreviation followed by a slant (/).
Segment 2 - For developers, enter the development authorization number followed by a slant (/); for other development activities, assign a development number followed by a slant (/).
Segment 3 - Enter the number 118, indicating the FSI Index form, followed by a slant (/).
Segment 4 - Enter the ESWBS number from block 1.
